about: The proof profile: TextEdit, built into every Mac, stands in for an iPhone app so the recorder, the display and the input are proven on a fleet Mac before any App Store app is installed. Points are fractions of the window (title bar included). A real app's profile has the same shape; profiles of other companies' apps are passed in with profile= (base64url JSON) and kept outside this repo.
name: textedit

cold-launch-to-typing.note: open -b of a quit app, its document reopened

scroll-fling.note: one trackpad-phase swipe of 12 events at 120 Hz

scroll-to-bottom.note: Cmd-Down: TextEdit has no jump-to-bottom button

steps.text: typing past one line into several lines of text, as a composer grows, then more words

composer-grow.note: typed by HID key events; TextEdit's document grows instead of a composer

new-chat.note: Cmd-N opens a new document window

keyboard-show.unsupported: an app on a Mac has no software keyboard: the hardware keyboard types directly, nothing slides up

keyboard-hide.unsupported: an app on a Mac has no software keyboard

attach-image.unsupported: the proof profile does not open a picker
